notes.title: Discover What’s New in Goblin Journal Demo #2
notes.content: [h2]Greetings, archivists and adventurers![/h2][p]The second Goblin Journal demo is here, now featuring a full tutorial! A dedicated level guides you through the goblins’ adventures and reveals the secrets of their journals through the translator’s story. It’s a perfect introduction for new players and a chance for veterans to explore the improvements we’ve made.[/p][p][/p][h2]A complete tutorial level with its own story[/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45594843/305e0f824b7ace82efe787f2b0a2ba84f8dde225.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Also new in this demo[/h3][list][*][p]Updated tooltips for items, abilities, and statuses.[/p][/*][*][p]Showing the squad members who survived the combat.[/p][/*][*][p]Enemy intention system updates and new combat animations (hit, blood, death).[/p][/*][*][p]Initiative calculation with a d6 roll, action point costs, and turn order indicators.[/p][/*][*][p]Visual enhancements: shadows for combatants, fort building labels, placeholders for empty arena positions, and dimming inactive combatants.[/p][/*][*][p]Squad panel layout and background improvements.[/p][/*][/list][h3]New features and quality-of-life updates[/h3][list][*][p]Reworked some orders (action, target, buff)[/p][/*][*][p]Added rest punishment (pursuers advance)[/p][/*][*][p]One sleep per fort visit[/p][/*][*][p]Combatant death animation[/p][/*][*][p]Equipment now respects HP, preventing accidental losses[/p][/*][*][p]New items, including tools to knock back pursuers on the map[/p][/*][/list][h3]Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed food display over “zzz” on the map[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed selling duplicate instances in fort[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed saving bag after removing or equipping items[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed position status application[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed armor locking in combat[/p][/*][*][p]Saved fort item and hire pool state between visits[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed goblins spawning with 0 HP[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed stun, haste, and hold status behavior[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed random initiative recalculation at round start in some cases[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed equipping armor during events so it’s not lost from inventory[/p][/*][/list][h3]Localization[/h3][p]We’re also excited to announce that Goblin Journal will be localized into several languages this September, including Russian, French, German, and Spanish.[/p][hr][/hr][p][b]Why your feedback matters:[/b] Every suggestion helps us make the game sharper, more immersive, and funnier in all the right ways. [/p][p][b]What’s next:[/b] Expanded journals, item synergy, advanced enemies, and much more await in the full version. Download the demo, explore the tutorial, and share your discoveries on Steam or Discord![/p][p]— The Goblin Journal dev team[/p]

notes.title: Demo Launch Announcement — Goblin Journal
notes.content:
[h2][b]Greetings, archivists and adventurers![/b][/h2][p]The first playable slice of [b]Goblin Journal[/b] has just landed on Steam, letting you translate one complete journal (three procedural maps) and lead a scrappy squad of goblins through tactical turn-based battles — all while uncovering the mystery behind an ancient, rune-sealed box.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]What’s inside the demo?[/h3][list][*][p]🗺️ [b]3 handcrafted levels[/b] built from our procedural map system (forest cliffs, river chapel, storm-torn pass).[/p][/*][*][p]⚔️ [b]Mandatory intro battles[/b] on each map + plenty of random events in between.[/p][/*][*][p]🛡️ [b]Four goblin classes[/b] — Commander, Shield, Pair, Dual — each with six swappable abilities.[/p][/*][*][p]👜 [b]Starter backpack[/b] of consumables (buffs, tricks, map tools) — experiment away![/p][/*][*][p]📜 [b]Original narrative[/b]: translated journal pages, sketched illustrations, and the first hints about those glowing runes…[/p][/*][*][p]🎨 Hand-painted art, moody soundtrack, and just the right amount of dark-fantasy grit.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]How to play[/h3][olist][*][p][b]Download the demo on our Steam page[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Jump straight into Journal I and guide your goblins to the end of Level 3.[/p][/*][*][p]Share screenshots, bugs, or wild strategies in our [url="https://discord.com/invite/4HgxaDFcP6"]Discord[/url] — we’re listening![/p][/*][/olist][hr][/hr][p][b]Why your feedback matters[/b][/p][p]This is an alpha-content demo; balance numbers, UI polish, and mechanics will continue to evolve. Every suggestion you drop in Steam discussions or Discord helps us sharpen the blades (and maybe lower the knights’ accuracy a tad).[/p][hr][/hr][p][b]What’s next?[/b][/p][list][*][p]Expanded journals, item synergy, and advanced enemy characters in the full version.[/p][/*][*][p]Release date? When the last rune clicks into place — wishlist to get the ping![/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][b]Play the demo, wishlist the game, and tell us what secrets you uncover.
See you on the battlefield — and between the lines of the Goblin Journal.[/b][/p][p]— The [i]Goblin Journal[/i] dev team 📕✨[/p]
